name: scope-statement-writing
description: Produce a scope statement: project purpose, objectives with success criteria, deliverables + acceptance, explicit in-scope and out-of-scope lists, assumptions, constraints, exclusions, boundaries (organizational / geographic / temporal / technical), key stakeholders, approval authority. Scope-change protocol. Distinct from WBS (structural decomposition) and from business case (investment rationale). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
